info.name: Sukrtya Siwan
info.description:
Sukrtya Siwan backend API.

**Production API:** `https://sukrtyasiwanapi.psmri.in` — set collection variable **`baseUrl`** to this (no trailing slash) for deployed tests; use `http://localhost:<port>` for local JVM.

| Area | Method | Path | Auth |
|------|--------|------|------|
| Login | POST | `/api/auth/login` | None (JSON body) |
| Current user | GET | `/api/auth/me` | Bearer JWT (folder **Me (JWT)**) |
| Master roster | GET | `/api/me/master-context` | Bearer JWT |
| Dashboard summary | GET | `/api/admin/dashboard/summary` | None (dev; `/api/admin/**` is open) |
| Master Excel import | POST | `/api/admin/masters/import-excel` | None (multipart `file`) |
| Forms catalog (CRUD) | GET/POST/PUT | `/api/admin/forms[/{code}]` | None (dev) |
| Forms activate/deactivate | POST | `/api/admin/forms/{code}/activate` or `/deactivate` | None (dev) |
| Delete form (soft) | DELETE | `/api/admin/forms/{code}` | None (dev) |
| Delete form (permanent) | DELETE | `/api/admin/forms/{code}?permanent=true` | None (dev) |
| Forms option-sets | GET | `/api/admin/forms/option-sets` | None (dev) |
| Forms Excel import | POST | `/api/admin/forms/import-excel` | None (multipart `file`) |
| Form schema (dynamic render) | GET | `/api/forms/{code}/schema?beneficiaryId=` | Bearer JWT |
| Beneficiary list under ASHA | GET | `/api/asha/{ashaAssignmentId}/beneficiaries` | Bearer JWT |
| Register pregnant woman (BASIC) | POST | `/api/asha/{ashaAssignmentId}/beneficiaries` | Bearer JWT |
| Beneficiary detail | GET | `/api/beneficiaries/{id}` | Bearer JWT |
| Update BASIC | PUT | `/api/beneficiaries/{id}` | Bearer JWT |
| Get form response | GET | `/api/beneficiaries/{id}/forms/{code}` | Bearer JWT |
| Submit/Update form response | POST | `/api/beneficiaries/{id}/forms/{code}` | Bearer JWT |

**`{{baseUrl}}`** defaults to production API below.

**Token:** Run **Login**; Tests save `{{accessToken}}`. **Me (JWT)** and **Beneficiary (JWT)** folders use Bearer from the folder.

**Credentials:** `{{adminUsername}}` / `{{adminPassword}}`; CHO `{{choUsername}}` / `{{choPassword}}`.

**Collection variables:** `formCode`, `ashaAssignmentId`, `beneficiaryId` — set manually or via Tests scripts on master-context / register.

**Workflows:**
- **Admin → Forms** — create catalog (BASIC, ANC1–4, PNC, …) → upload Excel → list → fetch one → soft/permanent delete if needed.
- **Beneficiary (JWT)** — login as CHO → master-context for `ashaAssignmentId` → register BASIC → list → schema + submit ANC/PNC.

variable.description: API root. Production: https://sukrtyasiwanapi.psmri.in — for local dev set to http://localhost:<server.port> (no trailing slash).
Filled by Login requests (Tests). Used by Me (JWT) folder Bearer auth.
Form catalog code for Admin → Forms and Beneficiary (JWT) requests (e.g. BASIC, ANC1, ANC2, ANC3, ANC4, PNC).
facility_worker_assignment.id where role=ASHA. Look up via /api/me/master-context → facilities[].staff[] (the one whose roleName starts with 'ASHA').
beneficiary.id. Filled after registering a pregnant woman via POST /api/asha/{ashaAssignmentId}/beneficiaries (the Tests script auto-saves it).

item.name: Auth
item.description: Public. Successful login stores `accessToken` on the collection.

request.description: `POST /api/auth/login` — JSON `username`, `password`. Response: `accessToken`, `tokenType`, `expiresInSeconds`, `role`, `username`, `displayName`.
Same path as admin login; username = CHO **mobile** (10 digits).

item.name: Me (JWT)
item.description: Bearer `{{accessToken}}` is set on **this folder** — child requests inherit it. Log in under **Auth** first.

request.description: `GET /api/auth/me` — `userId`, `username`, `displayName`, `role`. **401** if token missing/invalid.

exec: console.log('No ASHA assignmentId found in master-context; set {{ashaAssignmentId}} manually.');

request.description:
`GET /api/me/master-context` — `scope`, user fields, `facilities[]` (district, block, facility, `staff[]` with `assignmentId`, `roleName`, `workerName`).

Tests script saves the **first ASHA** `assignmentId` to `{{ashaAssignmentId}}` (skips ASHA_FACILITATOR). Pick a different ASHA manually if needed.
`GET /api/admin/dashboard/summary` — `geography`, `activeStaffAssignmentsByRole`, `facilityWorkerAssignmentsByStatus`, `portalUserFacility`, `choAtActiveFacilities`, `healthWorkers`.
`POST /api/admin/masters/import-excel` — multipart `file`. **200** / **400** JSON.

item.name: Forms
item.description:
Admin CRUD for the form catalog (BASIC, ANC1..4, PNC, etc.) plus Excel upload for questions + option sets.

**Suggested order:**
1. **Seed catalog** — run `Create form — BASIC` through `Create form — ANC4` and `Create form — PNC` once. Re-runs return **409 Conflict** (safe).
2. **List forms** — verify all catalog rows (sequence: BASIC 10, ANC1 20, … ANC4 50, PNC 60).
3. **Import forms Excel** — multipart upload of `SukrtyaQuestion.xlsx`. Each affected form's `version` bumps; `form_question` rows are replaced (no DB wipe needed).
4. **Get form (one)** — inspect questions + inlined `options[]` (set `{{formCode}}`).
5. **List option sets** — confirm OptionMaster-derived sets.
6. **Delete** — soft delete (`DELETE` without query) when form has live data; permanent (`?permanent=true`) only when no responses and no dependent prerequisites.

**New form from Excel:** create catalog row first (`POST /api/admin/forms`), set Form column in Excel, then re-import.

**Heads-up:** Yes/No questions referencing OptionMaster id `2` when only `0/1` exist — fix Excel or OptionMaster before import.

request.description: `GET /api/admin/forms` — array of `FormSummary` (id, code, name, sequence, prerequisiteCode, description, active, version, questionCount, updatedAt). Sorted by sequence then name.

`GET /api/admin/forms/{code}` — `FormDetail` = `{ form: FormSummary, questions: FormQuestionView[] }`. Each question carries:

• `code` — stable JSON key (e.g. `BASIC_16`, `ANC1_24`); used to look up answers in `beneficiary_form_response.answers`.
• `answerType` — `TEXT` / `NUMERIC` / `DATE` / `SINGLE_CHOICE` / `MULTI_CHOICE`.
• `mandatory`, `minValue`, `maxValue`, `defaultValue`, `skipValue` / `skipToQid`.
• `optionSetCode` — for choice questions, the reference code of the deduplicated option set (e.g. `OPT_1_2`).
• `options[]` — **inlined dropdown values** for SINGLE/MULTI choice questions. Each entry is `{ value, labelEn, labelHi, sequence }`. `null` for non-choice questions; an **empty array** means the question references an `optionSetCode` whose values have not been imported yet (check `OptionMaster` sheet).
• `computedKind` / `computedSourceCode` / `computedOffsetDays` — present for derived fields like `EDD = BASIC_16 + 280 days`.
• `sequence` — display order within the form.

**For frontend rendering, prefer `GET /api/forms/{code}/schema` under *Beneficiary (JWT)*** — same shape plus prefilled computed values when a beneficiary is bound.

body.raw:
{
  "code": "BASIC",
  "name": "Basic Details of Pregnant Woman",
  "sequence": 10,
  "description": "Initial registration form — captures village, name, husband name, mobile, ABHA, age, LMP. EDD is computed (LMP + 280 days).",
  "active": true
}

request.description: `PUT /api/admin/forms/{code}` — replace metadata. Renaming the code is allowed only if the new code does not already exist (otherwise **409**).
`POST /api/admin/forms/{code}/deactivate` — flips `active=false`. Returns the updated `FormSummary`.
`POST /api/admin/forms/{code}/activate` — flips `active=true`.

`DELETE /api/admin/forms/{code}` — **soft delete** (default). Sets `active=false`. Returns updated `FormSummary`. Safe when beneficiaries already submitted this form; historical JSONB responses remain valid.

Same effect as `POST /api/admin/forms/{code}/deactivate`.

`DELETE /api/admin/forms/{code}?permanent=true` — **hard delete**. Removes the form row and all `form_question` rows (cascade).

**Blocked (409)** when:
- Any `beneficiary_form_response` exists for this form (use soft delete instead).
- Another form lists this code as `prerequisiteCode` (e.g. cannot delete BASIC while ANC1 exists).

**204 No Content** on success. Use for catalog mistakes (e.g. wrong PNC created, no data submitted yet).
`GET /api/admin/forms/option-sets` — all option sets imported from the **OptionMaster** sheet (YES_NO, CATEGORISATION, HRP_TYPES, ...). Each set returns its `values[]`.

formdata.description:
Workbook (.xlsx / .xls). Use `SukrtyaQuestion.xlsx` from the repo root, or any file with the same shape:

• **Question Master** (required) — columns recognised (case- & space-insensitive):
   `faQID`, `Form Name` (optional), `faQuestionEN`, `faQuestionHI`, `faAnswer`, `skipAnswer`, `skiptoQuestion`, `faAnswerType` (Text / Numeric / Date / Single Choice / Multi Choice), `isMandate` or `isMandatory` (0/1/-), `maxvalue`, `minvalue`, `Remarks`.
• **OptionMaster** (optional) — flat lookup with columns `OptionID`, `OptionNameEN`, `OptionNameReg`.

Field name must be `file`.

request.description:
`POST /api/admin/forms/import-excel` — multipart `file`.

**Section detection (per row, in order):**
1. Explicit `Form Name` cell, normalised + aliased (`Basic Details` → `BASIC`, `1st ANC` → `ANC1`, etc.).
2. Inference from question text: rows like `Due date of ... 1st/2nd/3rd/4th ANC` start sections `ANC1..4`.
3. Sticky carry-forward from the previous row.
4. Default `BASIC` for rows before any marker.

Rows with blank `faAnswerType` (e.g. District / Block / HWC / CHO / ASHA headers in rows 2–8) are silently skipped — they're geography metadata, not form fields.

**Options:** for SINGLE/MULTI CHOICE rows, `faAnswer` is parsed as a slash-separated list of OptionMaster IDs (`1/2`, `3/4/5`, `19/20`, ...). The parser **auto-creates deduplicated option sets** — each unique sorted ID list becomes one set (e.g. `OPT_1_2`, `OPT_3_4_5`).

**Computed fields:** `Remarks` patterns like `LMP Date + 280 Days` become `computedKind=DATE_OFFSET`, `computedSourceCode=<source question's stable code>`, `computedOffsetDays=280`. Source lookup is global across all forms in the same upload.

**Behaviour summary:**
- For each detected form, the catalog row must already exist (use *Create form — ...* first). If missing, those questions are skipped with a clear message.
- Existing `form_question` rows for each affected form are **deleted and replaced**; `form.version` is incremented by 1.
- Each referenced option set is **wholesale replaced** so re-uploading propagates label changes.

**Response (200):** `{ success, questionsImported, questionsSkipped, optionsImported, questionsByForm: { BASIC: 10, ANC1: 12, ANC2: 12, ANC3: 12, ANC4: 27, PNC: 8 }, messages: [warnings] }` (counts vary with Excel).

**Re-import:** no DB clean needed; questions per form are replaced and `form.version` increments.

**Tip:** run `python scripts/preview_form_import.py` for a dry-run before upload.

item.name: Beneficiary (JWT)
item.description:
Pregnant-woman tracker. Bearer `{{accessToken}}` is applied at this folder level; log in under **Auth** first.

**End-to-end flow:**
1. **Login — CHO** (under *Auth*) — saves `{{accessToken}}`.
2. **Get master context** (under *Me (JWT)*) — find your ASHA in `facilities[].staff[]` (roleName starts with `ASHA`); copy its `assignmentId` into `{{ashaAssignmentId}}`.
3. **GET form schema (BASIC)** — confirm the exact question codes for your imported Excel.
4. **POST Register pregnant woman** — body is the BASIC answers keyed by question code; Tests script saves `{{beneficiaryId}}`.
5. **GET List beneficiaries under ASHA** — verify she appears.
6. **GET form schema (ANC1, with beneficiaryId)** — see prefill (`BASIC_16` LMP) and computed `Due date of ANC 1` resolved.
7. **POST Submit form response (ANC1)** — write ANC1 answers; rerun the POST to update them.

**Authorization:** non-admin users only see/write beneficiaries at facilities they are mapped to via `portal_user_facility`. Admin is unrestricted.

**Validation:** every write path runs through `FormResponseValidator` — mandatory fields, numeric/date min-max, option-membership against the configured `form_question` rows. **400** with a list of violations on failure.

request.description:
`GET /api/forms/{code}/schema` — dynamic schema for one form, **no beneficiary bound**.

Returns:
- `form` — `FormSummary` (code, name, sequence, version, prerequisiteCode).
- `questions[]` — each with `code`, `faQid`, `labelEn`, `answerType`, `mandatory`, `minValue`/`maxValue`, `options[]` (expanded inline from the referenced `option_set`), `skip` (`ifValue`, `toQuestionCode`), `computed` (kind, sourceQuestionCode, offsetDays — `resolvedValue` is null without a beneficiary), `currentValue: null`, `sequence`.
- `prefill: {}` — empty (no beneficiary).
- `response.exists: false`.

This is what the frontend hits to render the empty BASIC form when registering a new pregnant woman.

`GET /api/forms/{code}/schema?beneficiaryId={id}` — same as above, but bound to a beneficiary.

With a beneficiary:
- `prefill` is populated with **all** of her saved answers across **all** forms, plus a `beneficiary.*` namespace for hot columns (`beneficiary.lmpDate`, `beneficiary.fullName`, ...). Use this to render cross-form context (e.g. show LMP at the top of ANC1).
- `computed[].resolvedValue` is filled in — e.g. EDD = LMP + 280, ANC1 due = LMP + 84.
- For questions she has already answered, `currentValue` echoes the saved value so edits show existing data.
- `response` block has `exists`, `status`, `formVersion`, `submittedAt`, `updatedAt`.

Try `{{formCode}} = ANC1` after BASIC is saved — you'll see the due date pre-resolved.

`GET /api/asha/{ashaAssignmentId}/beneficiaries` — pregnant women registered under one ASHA, newest first.

Each entry is a `BeneficiarySummary` with hot columns plus `formStatus[]` (one row per catalog form):

| Field | Meaning |
|-------|--------|
| `formActive` | `true` = form enabled in catalog; `false` = soft-deleted (`DELETE` without `permanent=true`) |
| `collectionState` | Why there is or isn't data — see below |
| `exists` | Beneficiary has a saved response row for this form |
| `status` | `DRAFT` / `SUBMITTED` when `exists` is true |

**`collectionState` values:**
- `NOT_STARTED` — form active, no data yet (show empty / pending)
- `DRAFT` / `SUBMITTED` — form active, data exists
- `FORM_INACTIVE` — form soft-deleted, never filled (hide from collection; explains empty slot)
- `FORM_INACTIVE_HAS_DATA` — form soft-deleted but historical answers exist (read-only)

**403** if not mapped to the ASHA's facility. **404** if ASHA assignment invalid.

`POST /api/asha/{ashaAssignmentId}/beneficiaries` — register a new pregnant woman under one ASHA.

**Body** is the BASIC answers keyed by question code (from `GET /api/admin/forms/BASIC`):
- The codes above are placeholders shaped like the user's `SukrtyaQuestion.xlsx` (`BASIC_8..BASIC_16`). **Run `GET /api/admin/forms/BASIC` first** and adjust to your actual codes.
- LMP (`BASIC_16`) should be ISO `yyyy-mm-dd`; `dd/MM/yyyy` and `dd-MM-yyyy` are also accepted.
- `EDD` (`BASIC_17`) is **computed server-side** as LMP + 280; do not include it in the body — anything you send is ignored on re-read.
- `status` defaults to `SUBMITTED`; use `DRAFT` for partial saves.

**Server-side:**
- Validates against `form_question` (mandatory, min/max, option membership).
- Auto-projects hot fields onto `beneficiary` columns (name, husband, mobile, ABHA, village, age, LMP, EDD) by matching question labels — code names like `BASIC_9` are not hardcoded.
- Generates a unique beneficiary code (`BEN-YYYY-XXXXXX`).
- Writes the BASIC JSONB to `beneficiary_form_response`.

**201 Created** with the new `BeneficiarySummary`. **400** on validation failure. **403** if you can't write to this ASHA's facility. **409** if same mobile or ABHA already registered at that facility (open existing record — do not POST BASIC again; use `PUT /api/beneficiaries/{id}`).

The Tests script saves the new id to `{{beneficiaryId}}`.

`GET /api/beneficiaries/{id}` — full detail for one pregnant woman.

Returns:
- `beneficiary` — `BeneficiarySummary` (typed columns + per-form status grid).
- `basicAnswers` — the raw JSONB from her BASIC response (useful for an edit screen).
- `forms[]` — same grid as `beneficiary.formStatus` (one entry per catalog form, with `exists` / `status` / `submittedAt`).

**403** if you do not have access to her facility.

`PUT /api/beneficiaries/{id}` — replace the BASIC answers + re-project hot beneficiary columns.

Same validator as register. The BASIC `beneficiary_form_response` row is updated in place (its `form_version` is bumped to the current catalog version, useful after a re-import). LMP changes automatically re-compute EDD.

`GET /api/beneficiaries/{id}/forms/{formCode}` — read the most recent response for one (beneficiary, form) pair.

Returns `BeneficiaryFormResponseView` (id, beneficiaryId, formCode, formName, formVersion, status, answers, submittedAt, updatedAt). **404** if she has not been opened on that form yet — call **GET form schema (with beneficiary)** instead to render a blank form.

`POST /api/beneficiaries/{id}/forms/{formCode}` — upsert a follow-up form response (`ANC1`–`ANC4`, `PNC`, any future form).

Set `{{formCode}}` (e.g. `ANC1`, `PNC`). Confirm answer keys via `GET /api/admin/forms/{code}` or `GET /api/forms/{code}/schema?beneficiaryId=`.

Validator runs (mandatory / min-max / option membership). Computed fields are evaluated on read — do not rely on submitting them.

Upserts in place if a response already exists. **400** if `formCode = BASIC` — use `PUT /api/beneficiaries/{id}` for BASIC edits.
